definitions.short: Seba , a son of Cush, and the country settled by him
definitions.full: H5434. Seba סְבָא proper name, masculine 1st son of Cush , in poetry and late; — Gen 10:7 (P) ( ᵐ5 Σαβα , as שְׁבָא ) = 1Chr 1:9 ( ᵐ5 id. , but B Σαβατ ); = nation (or territory) Psa 72:10 ( ᵐ5 Σαβα ; + ᵐ5 שְׁבָא, Αραβων ), so (+ כּוּשׁ , || מִצְרַיִם ) Isa 43:3 ( ᵐ5 Σοηνη ); clearly situated in south; most probably = λιμὴν Σαβά , and Σαβαὶ πόλις εὐμεγέθης , in Adulic gulf on west coast of Red Sea; see Strabo xvi. 4. 8. 10 Ptol iv. 7, 7 f. Di Gn Bae Psalm Du Is ; > Meroë Jos Ant. ii. 10 , 2 and others

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute.
For I am Yahweh your God,
